lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in parallel horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible lattice pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features along the upper third of the flank exhibit a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with light-colored upper edges and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, high-luminance silhouettes (remoras) are positioned ventrally, one near the pectoral fin trailing edge and one further posterior.
